summary: Full e2e test of BCND Jaarformulier & Nascholingsadministratie. Backend: 24/24 pytest passed (auth, authz, member/admin endpoints, listings, settings, logout). Frontend: admin login->/admin dashboard OK, member login->/ dashboard shows 8/8 pts + 34/40 consults + banner OK, member can create new bijscholing (status Ingediend), consulten update auto-computes total and save toast shows, jaarformulier page loads with member data, notifications panel opens and lists items, admin can review+approve training (status flips to Goedgekeurd, notification is generated), admin settings/members/jaarformulieren pages load with expected data-testid buttons, authz enforced (member GET on /admin routes redirected to /, /admin/dashboard etc return 401/403 for member).

minor.issue: Requires authenticated user; misleading naming '/public' suggests unauthenticated access. Currently returns 401 anonymous.

issues: 'Datum' field uses native browser date input (type=date) instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component; inconsistent with rest of the design and against the internal guideline to avoid browser native picker.

action_items: Optional: replace native <input type="date"> in 'Nieuwe bijscholing' dialog with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker (data-testid=training-date preserved).
Consider making /api/settings/public truly public (no auth) or rename to reflect that it requires auth.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.login returns flat user object; frontend Login expects u.role directly so this is consistent, but standardising as {user: {...}, token?} would be more conventional.
annual_forms.py: _get_or_create_form inserts a new form on every GET when none exists (side effect on read); consider making the endpoint idempotent or explicit.
settings_routes.py: '/settings/public' name is misleading; it still calls get_current_user.
